financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Registered direct offering of 2,500,000 common shares at $2.00; proceeds shown after the 7% placement agent fee and before other expenses. Closing was expected on or around July 23, 2026, and the filings do not confirm that it closed.
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: The closing is expected to occur on or around July 23, 2026 (the “Closing Date”).
